title: kithd: bind_to_ips must reject unspecified address 0.0.0.0
description: bind_to_ips in listener.rs accepts any IpAddr parsed from tailscaled /status without checking is_unspecified(). If a misconfigured or compromised tailscaled returns 0.0.0.0 in TailscaleIPs, kithd will bind on all interfaces and serve the full JMAP API to the public internet, violating the tailnet-only invariant. Fix: add a guard before TcpListener::bind that skips and logs an error for any ip.is_unspecified() address.
